How the supplied assets become the campaign creative

A demo creative workflow: the supplied product original sets the identity, the campaign hero sets the atmosphere, and the supplied video preview is the moving result. No image or video is generated live in this POC.

Demo creative workflow
Provided demo assets
01
Product original

The clean SERENITY original places the exact bottle and Lavish mark on a quiet ivory field at true aspect ratio, before any atmosphere is added. It is the fixed identity reference that every later frame must keep legible.

The supplied white-background SERENITY bottle, kept true to the original. · Provided demo asset · Not generated live in this POC

02
Campaign hero

The lifestyle hero adds warm amber light and soft floral-inspired shadow as mood. The bottle mark stays fully visible, and the branch, stone and flower props are art direction rather than ingredient evidence.

The supplied lifestyle visual that sets the atmosphere. · Provided demo asset · Not generated live in this POC

03
Final video

The provided 10.08-second, 720×960 clip shows warm still-life, bottle-label close-ups and a return to the single-bottle setting. It is an independent provided preview, not a render of the 15-second four-shot concept script.

The provided 10.08-second, 720×960 independent preview. · Provided demo asset · Not generated live in this POC
